summary.title: Introduction | 3D Game Development with LWJGL 3
summary.one_liner: An online book that teaches the core concepts of writing a 3D game in Java using the LWJGL 3 library, which wraps native OpenGL, OpenAL and OpenCL APIs.
keywords: how to write a 3d game in java
takeaways: LWJGL 3 is a Java library giving access to native OpenGL, OpenAL and OpenCL APIs with native-level performance.
The book covers the main concepts needed to write a 3D game using LWJGL 3.
Source code for the samples is on GitHub under Apache v2.0; the book text is CC BY-SA 4.0.
An older version of the book is on GitHub, and GitBook legacy lwjglgamedev.gitbooks.io URLs are out of sync.
summary.summary: This is the introduction page of an online book by Antonio Hernández Bejarano on 3D game development with LWJGL 3. It explains that LWJGL is a Java library exposing native graphics (OpenGL), audio (OpenAL) and parallel computing (OpenCL) APIs. The author describes organizing scattered online OpenGL material into a book. The page also links to the source code for samples and the book, licensing terms, a previous version, and a Vulkan book by the same author.
